messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: starting deployment release/2026-03-15-canary -> prod (canary 5%). config change includes ENV KMS_KEY_ROTATE=true and new key projects/redwood-kms/keys/rls-2026
eng_release_ben: copying notes to thread. watching canary metrics and health checks now.
incbot: :rotating_light: paging @sre_oncall_kim — canary health checks failing, inference-runtime pods returning 5xx. creating incident INC-2193.
sre_oncall_kim: on it. pulling pod logs & health checks. which hosts are in the canary pool?
devops_tina: canary hosts: gke-prod-us-central-1-{a..e}. logs show repeated KMS decrypt errors in inference-worker: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z ERROR inference-worker: failed to decrypt model-key: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Cloud KMS: request failed: permissionDenied
stack: google.rpc.PermissionDenied
```

support_emma: customer-support seeing spike in 500s on hosted API. two enterprise tenants reported failures for small batches. routing them to status page and collecting request ids.
eng_release_ben: auto-rollback attempted (configured) but rollback stalled at ~40% because some instances still pick up new config with feature flag `use-new-kms-auth` true. suspect mixed config propagation.
sre_oncall_kim: can you confirm IAM bindings on the new key? if service account can't decrypt, that explains failures.
devops_tina: running quick check: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy rls-2026 --project=redwood-kms` shows missing binding for serviceAccount:inference-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. rotation job applied key but CI job that updates IAM failed silently.
pm_jordan: tagging infra change owners — this rotation was part of #4567 (kms rotation).
eng_release_ben: okay, manual mitigation: 1) flip feature flag kill-switch `use-new-kms-auth` -> false 2) add missing IAM binding 3) resume rollback / remove canary. who can flip the flag now?
devops_tina: I can add the IAM binding now. applying: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding rls-2026 --member=serviceAccount:inference-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
sre_oncall_kim: flipping LD flag now: `LD user:eng_release_ben toggled use-new-kms-auth -> false`
eng_release_ben: toggled. attempting to resume rollback.
incbot: auto-rollback resumed. progress: 40% -> 100%. removing canary nodes from rotation.
support_emma: support metrics: total unique failed requests ~120, peak error rate 3.2% (14:01-14:11 UTC). we've posted customer note on status.redwood.ai and notified the two affected tenants directly.
sre_oncall_kim: verifying surface: running smoke on hosted API and embedding endpoints. all endpoints returning 200s on quick checks. I'll run a sampling of traces for upstream errors.
sre_oncall_lee: taking over monitoring for 30m while kim writes initial incident summary. I'll keep CI and rollout automation on watch.
sre_oncall_kim: handoff: incident state -> mitigated, rollback complete, root cause suspected: KMS rotation automated workflow didn't update key IAM bindings for the inference service account, resulting in decrypt permission denied during canary. immediate mitigations: manual IAM binding + feature-flag kill-switch then rollback.
pm_jordan: creating postmortem ticket PM-1234, linking PR #4567 (kms rotation), deploy artifacts, and this incident thread. assigning owners: devops_tina (IAM fix and rollout durability), eng_release_ben (release checklist), sre_oncall_lee (post-incident monitoring/validation).
eng_release_ben: action items we discussed: - add preflight check in release pipeline to validate KMS IAM bindings after rotation - add invariant test that verifies feature flags propagate to all canary nodes before traffic shift - make rollback fully decoupled from feature flags (can't be blocked by mixed config)
support_emma: customers notified and follow-ups scheduled. sending summary to affected accounts now.
devops_tina: will update rotation job and add retries + alert when IAM changes don't apply. also posting a doc snippet for next rotations.
sre_oncall_lee: monitoring logs for 30m. if error rate >0.5% for 10m re-paging SRE.
eng_release_ben: thanks everyone. incident marked: mitigated -> will keep thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
incbot: incident INC-2193 status -> mitigated. creating timeline entry and reminding to attach logs and the release PR to postmortem.
